summary: Frontend-only targeted splash/startup verification completed on public preview. Config/code checks pass for new Mello splash asset usage and startup BrandSplash wiring. Web automation confirmed splash logo metrics (centered/contained, gray background) under controlled font-request hold, but Playwright screenshot capture during held-font state failed repeatedly due tool-level font-ready blocking; this is a test tooling limitation, not confirmed app regression.

integration_issues.issue: When intentionally holding font requests (to keep BrandSplash visible), Playwright screenshot API waits for fonts and times out, so direct screenshot proof of held-font splash could not be captured despite successful DOM/testID visibility and geometry metrics.

integration_issues.flow: Session restoration with real /api/auth/me held briefly
integration_issues.issue: Selector-based loading-state detection succeeded, but one captured frame was blank/transition state; visual capture is timing-sensitive without introducing artificial delay.

action_items: If strict screenshot proof is mandatory for held-font startup, use a capture mechanism that does not block on document.fonts.ready (or capture from native build instrumentation/video), since Playwright screenshot blocks by design.
Validate native launch splash on freshly installed Android/iOS build; web preview cannot prove OS-native splash rendering lifecycle.
Optional testing hardening: expose a deterministic non-production test hook/event for loading-logo visibility transitions to reduce racey blank-frame captures.
critical_code_review_comments: app.json expo-splash-screen plugin is correctly configured to splash-icon.png, imageWidth 200, resizeMode contain, background #EBEBED, and explicit dark mode uses same image/background.
BrandSplash uses bundled local asset require(@/assets/images/splash-icon.png) with fixed gray background and no network image dependency.
RootLayout keeps native splash hideAsync tied to rendered root onLayout only when ready, matching requested startup-transition pattern.
Index/AuthRouteBoundary presentation changed to BrandSplash (app-loading/session-loading) while auth redirect logic remains unchanged.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (config/code/startup logic and viewport metrics passed; held-font screenshot evidence blocked by tooling limitation)

seed_data_creation: Used existing QA user login only: qa_tester_b40dc299@linguatest.com. No credential/storage mutation performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Controlled font-delay checks were done without mocked API bodies and confirmed via DOM metrics: 390x844, 320x568, 844x390 all returned splashBg rgb(235,235,237), logo 200x200, centerDx/centerDy 0, fullyContained true. Repeated screenshot attempts during held-font state timed out on Playwright font readiness. Treat those failures as automation limitations, not direct app failures.
rca_of_issue: RCA (test capture issue): Playwright screenshot pipeline waits for font readiness. In this task, fonts are intentionally held to keep pre-ready BrandSplash visible, creating a deadlock for screenshot capture. Reproduction: intercept .ttf/.woff request before initial navigation -> wait for mello-splash-screen-logo -> call page/locator screenshot -> timeout waiting for fonts. Mitigation: gather geometry/assertion evidence via DOM metrics during hold, then release requests; for visual proof, use video/native instrumentation or tooling that can capture without font-ready dependency.
